description: This file defines the 'LoginLog' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing login attempt logs stored in the database. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping and includes properties for user ID, username, user role, role type, and login time, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LoginLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a login event, mapped to the 'ohrm_login' database table.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user associated with this login log.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for this login log.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username associated with this login.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username for this login.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Returns the role name of the user.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the role name for the user.
